Legora@WeAreLegora· Nov 19
The November BAR results are now available, showing how AI models compare on real-world legal tasks in Legora.

A few highlights from this month’s results:

→ Muse Wonder ranks highest on overall quality and leads across four task types: analysis and answering, extraction, drafting, and editing.

→ GPT-6.2 Astra leads on comparison and review tasks, with overall quality 4% above November’s model average and cost per case 20% below average.

→ GPT-6.2 Sol delivers above-average quality at 78% below the average cost per case across models benchmarked in November.

AAA's national gas average is $3.72 a gallon, down from $4.56 in May, but still 60+ cents above a year ago and the most expensive November on record (34 likes).

Drop Site@DropSiteNews
⛽ Gas prices are falling: AAA's national average is $3.72 a gallon, down from $4.56 in May and $4.30 a month ago. But they're still more than 60 cents above a year ago, and this is the most expensive November on record.

The national average was under $3 before the US and Israel attacked Iran on Feb. 28. Diesel fell just below $6 a gallon on Monday for the first time since early September, according to AAA, after hitting a record $6.53 on Sept. 22.

Energy Secretary Chris Wright claims "more gasoline is flowing out of the Strait of Hormuz, more diesel is flowing out, more jet fuel is flowing out." Bloomberg has suggested that refined products are also exceeding previous months flow, but recent shipping data shows overall flows are falling.

AAA credits falling pump prices to cheaper crude and seasonal factors.
